findings.title: UGC render duration and testimonial semantics mismatch
findings.observed: Buffer UGC executor builds 2x10-second first-person generated ad scripts.
findings.expected: Genuine rights-cleared 30-second and separate 15-second medspa clips.
findings.root_cause: Existing UGC factory is product-ad-focused and not an editorial footage renderer.
findings.impact: Primary deliverable cannot be produced; synthetic patient-style claims risk.
findings.proposed_fix: Implement/reuse vetted licensed-source footage renderer on established engine with two actual MP4 outputs.
findings.acceptance_test: Use a licensed 30s+ source; produce two distinct H264 1080x1920 30/15 MP4s, hash and verify, no invented visitor.
dependencies: real video source and rights vault

findings.title: Cross-workspace source reference exposure/list leakage
findings.observed: Global Buffer source index formerly returned references without workspace scope; new PR #119 scopes exact lookup and filters Redis/Supabase.
findings.expected: Every external source read restricted to configured workspace and no mutable tenant from agent.
findings.root_cause: Global index + service-role queries need explicit workspace predicate.
findings.impact: Potential visibility of other customer assets and wrong-tenant creative selection.
findings.proposed_fix: Review/merge Buffer PR #119 and validate actual workspace + real asset readback.
findings.acceptance_test: Foreign-workspace exact read rejected on both Postgres and Redis, list scans past foreign entries before count.
evidence: Codex review found Redis pagination issue, code fixed + new tests

findings.title: No verified live Instinct/Paperclip or Buffer API connection
findings.observed: No live authenticated provider endpoint, workspace UUID, Instinct task or model-originated MCP receipts.
findings.expected: Voice-outcome to real agent workflow, durable plan and verifiable response.
findings.root_cause: Existing Paperclip identity and server topology unresolved (#25).
findings.impact: Primary agent promise unproven despite synthetic CI.
findings.proposed_fix: Server operator resolves issue #25 and proves real model-originated and live Buffer API readbacks.
findings.acceptance_test: Actual authenticated tool call IDs, deployment SHAs, source/plan IDs and failure/rollback receipts.
evidence: No connected runtime evidence from GitHub PR CI

findings.title: No real source-video ingestion path
findings.observed: Buffer references upload only accepts image/jpeg,png,webp ≤25MB; client job requires video.
findings.expected: Rights-cleared private video can enter pipeline and be durably verified at target sizes.
findings.root_cause: Image reference uploader and whole-body asset storage not designed for footage.
findings.impact: Video production cannot begin from authentic Crown & Core footage.
findings.proposed_fix: Reuse approved private vault/ingest or build streaming video source path with scoped provenance and checksum.
findings.acceptance_test: Upload representative large authorized footage with bounded memory, metadata, checksums, restart and private readback.

findings.title: Direct Buffer MCP exposes privileged paid factory
findings.observed: Buffer MCP catalog includes execute_ugc_ad_factory; Buffer operator key has broad authority.
findings.expected: Instinct sees only bounded no-spend tools; separate owner/wallet approval controls paid execution.
findings.root_cause: Existing general-purpose Buffer MCP is not intended to be directly exposed to medspa agent.
findings.impact: Agent could accidentally trigger paid generation with broad token if improperly registered.
findings.proposed_fix: Use StarNet scoped proxy only; never give Buffer operator key to Instinct; verify live registration.
findings.acceptance_test: Eleven allowed tools; no generic Buffer tool executor or raw operator token in model process.

findings.title: Redis degraded fallback changes canonical plan semantics
findings.observed: Buffer plan persistence falls back to Redis when Supabase is unavailable; response identifies backend.
findings.expected: Plan must be canonically durable for medspa production audit.
findings.root_cause: Provider's degraded fallback is not equivalent to canonical ledger.
findings.impact: A result could look saved without canonical proof.
findings.proposed_fix: StarNet bridge rejects anything except backend=supabase; server confirms actual durable readback.
findings.acceptance_test: Redis response must fail closed, Supabase saved plan must read back ID and exact content.

findings.title: OpenCodeReview model provider errors
findings.observed: Both repo OCR jobs failed: Buffer 2/2 provider/subtasks; Crown 12/12 non-JSON text/plain response from GitHub Models.
findings.expected: Independent OCR findings/success recorded at exact PR SHA.
findings.root_cause: GitHub Models completion endpoint responds in unsupported format or task fails.
findings.impact: Independent review remains incomplete; cannot call code security-approved.
findings.proposed_fix: Fix approved provider configuration and rerun pinned OCR or obtain qualified independent review.
findings.acceptance_test: Complete OCR report artifact or signed independent review, resolved material issues and exact SHA.
dependencies: working model provider and approved reviewer

findings.title: Single-host SQLite not operationally proven
findings.observed: StarNet uses experimental Node 22 node:sqlite single-writer store; unit restart tests pass.
findings.expected: Encrypted approved private volume, safe backup/restart and tenant isolation in real staging.
findings.root_cause: Repository cannot provision/verify owner's live storage.
findings.impact: Risk of data loss or deployment concurrency divergence.
findings.proposed_fix: Server agent inspects existing DB; run private backup/restore and single-writer limits before deploy.
findings.acceptance_test: Backup/restore, restart, tamper detection and approved encrypted storage proven.

findings.title: Real voice identity not bound to exact film hashes
findings.observed: StarNet OIDC RS256 MFA verifier and hash-bound film approval code exists; real voice channel not connected.
findings.expected: Owner or clinician identity is independently authenticated with scoped expiring version/hash challenge.
findings.impact: Spoken yes cannot be accepted as authenticated approval.
findings.proposed_fix: Connect verified owner channel to exact-version OIDC and challenge semantics; test replay and denial.
findings.acceptance_test: Real owner-approved film hash receipt and denied stale/spoofed voice decision.
evidence: Static code/CI tests, no production proof

findings.title: Plan metadata does not equal video generation
findings.observed: Buffer canonical draft contains duration_seconds=30 and metadata requested_cuts_seconds=[30,15] but no MP4.
findings.expected: Actual separate 30 and 15-second output and provider job receipt.
findings.root_cause: Provider API is no-spend plan store; generation factory incompatible.
findings.proposed_fix: Enforce paid_generation=false, renderer_supported=false until real files independently QA pass.
findings.acceptance_test: No mock asserts video exists; real independent 2 MP4 hashes needed.

findings.title: Whole-body media buffering and image-only upload
findings.observed: Buffer asset_storage.upload_file uses Path.read_bytes() before posting; uploader only accepts 25MB images.
findings.expected: Bounded-memory authenticated video transfer at realistic file sizes.
findings.root_cause: Existing storage helper predates large video ingest.
findings.impact: Memory pressure and failed large-footage imports.
findings.proposed_fix: Use streaming/chunked object transfer, size/checksum/expiry boundaries; do not increase limit alone.
findings.acceptance_test: ≥100MB authorized test file transferred with bounded memory and resume/failure receipt.

findings.title: Ad container / refund tracking overstatements
findings.observed: Existing Buffer 2026-08-31 audit notes Meta/TikTok create only campaign containers; refunds not fully netted.
findings.expected: Ads delivered only after complete hierarchy/readback, revenue net of returns.
findings.root_cause: Existing implementation's provider/ad and Shopify accounting incomplete.
findings.impact: Unreliable ROAS or paid campaign claims.
findings.proposed_fix: Keep paid media outside scope, separately fix and verify entire hierarchy and refund events.
findings.acceptance_test: Actual delivery receipts and refund-adjusted net numbers before claims.
evidence: Historical audit file and source inspection

findings.title: Offline owner fallback not connected to live voice/video approval
findings.observed: HTML prototype exports a JSON brief and copy prompt; does not send to a server or preview real MP4.
findings.expected: Owner delegates to Instinct and reviews verified artifact without desk.
findings.root_cause: UI was intentionally built offline pending server identity.
findings.impact: Owner cannot finish actual film through shown page today.
findings.proposed_fix: Connect existing Instinct voice/mobile surface; preserve low-text design and accessibility tests.
findings.acceptance_test: Voice-intent to actual MCP receipt, real mobile video playback and exact version approval.
evidence: Static UI code; no browser automation

findings.title: Actual production boundaries untested
findings.observed: No authorized production APIs, credentials or patient assets accessed during audit.
findings.expected: Verified tenant, provider and deployment version in owner-controlled staging.
findings.impact: Unverified security and operational assumptions remain.
findings.proposed_fix: Hand server operator bounded read-only discovery mission; no debug secrets in logs/issues.
findings.acceptance_test: Direct signed staging receipts for config, denial, provider version and rollback.

findings.title: Generic renderer adapter did not speak Buffer contract
findings.observed: StarNet generic provider bridge expects GET health/POST jobs, while Buffer exposes actual /api/health, /api/mcp and UGC plans.
findings.expected: Safe intermediary uses source-confirmed exact API paths.
findings.proposed_fix: PR #28 implements real existing status/list/reference/no-spend plan paths; render still separate.
findings.acceptance_test: Authenticated mocked calls match actual Buffer code; live readback pending.

findings.title: Critical vulnerable Next.js runtime dependency
findings.observed: Buffer frontend pins next@16.4.0; npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high fails with 1 critical vulnerability and three advisories.
findings.expected: Fix vulnerable runtime dependency and ensure no critical/high prod advisories before launch.
findings.root_cause: Preexisting frontend dependency behind existing Buffer production path.
findings.impact: Potential unauthenticated RCE/DoS if affected surfaces exposed; not confirmed exploitable.
findings.proposed_fix: Isolated version and lockfile upgrade, routes/build/lint/security regression, no blind force.
findings.acceptance_test: npm audit, npm ci, frontend build/lint/route smoke, real deployed reachability audit and rollback.

merge_gate: Block until independent code/security review, critical Next fixed, all CI green, owner review, and correct stacked dependency order.
deploy_gate: Block until live approved Instinct/Paperclip/Buffer tenant, JWT/rights/clinical identity, media vault, DB restore, actual video and rollback.
publish_spend_gate: Separate owner authorization, exact media hashes and source rights; do not expose Buffer paid factory to agent.
rollback: Revoke CROWN_BUFFER_* secrets, disable StarNet Buffer bridge, stop side effects, revert PRs and preserve receipts.
